No published image shows the errata text; [[Wedge In Red Squadron 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-112-Wedge_In_Red_Squadron_1-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009); the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, still on 12 December 2012) prints the same words: “Permanent pilot is •Wedge, who provides ability of 3. During a battle with opponent’s [Independent Starship] starship, may add one destiny to attrition or total power. Immune to Come With Me, Tallon Roll, and attrition < 4.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=13 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 13, slip 112.
